minAgeNotes.4: JUDGEMENT, NOT A CITATION. Bladder/bowel change is a genuine red flag and the most embarrassing thing to ask a child in a hospital corridor. Ranked FOURTH despite the floor, precisely because of it: it fires only for 8-12s where the cap is 6, so ranking it high costs a young child nothing.
minAgeNotes.6: Deliberately NOT floored, even though its nearest in-app equivalent SENSATIONS.tingly is tiers:['older']. Flooring it at 8 would make it duplicate `tingly` exactly where it fires and vanish exactly where the app has no other route to the concept. The answer is a tier-split WORDING, not a floor.

judgement.itemRank: Proposed, not yet confirmed by review.
judgement.mainEffect: This packet's main effect on the `back` group is NOT to add questions; it is to change which get asked. The three already-shipping hand-written questions (items 9, 10, 11) rank 7th, 12th and 14th -- a deliberate demotion.
judgement.factsToReuse: Item 3 -> feels-feverish. Item 14 -> limb-use. Everything else mints a new fact.
judgement.doNotMerge: Item 10 must NOT reuse `worse-on-exertion` (chest). That fact is chest pain on exertion, a cardiorespiratory discriminator; back pain worse on movement is a mechanical one. A child who taps Chest and Back will get two similar-sounding movement questions and that is the accepted cost.
judgement.vomitingIsAnAbsence: Item 35 records that `vomiting` is NOT reused: no source read names vomiting in a child with back pain. Writing that question here would be an invented citation.
judgement.neckNotAbsorbed: Decision 11: neck stiffness is NOT absorbed. Roadmap row 11 is a separate packet. This packet is scoped to upper and lower back.
judgement.wordingTrapsForGeneration: Two natural item wordings are blocked by screen.mjs's UNIVERSAL rules and must be rephrased, not fought: item 2's 'Does it hurt even when you are keeping still?' trips the global `still` presupposition ban, and item 13's 'Do you do a lot of sport?' trips the global `a lot` intensity ban. Neither is a packet-specific rule; both are in LEADING.
judgement.unenforceableCautions: Two cautions cannot be regexes. (a) Decision 1 rules out 'pins and needles' for the YOUNG tier only, and screen.mjs has no tier-conditional ban -- so the older tier's use of it is correct and the young tier's would have to be caught by eye. (b) 'stiff' alone is ruled out because SENSATIONS.stiff is a different fact; not banned outright because item 8 may legitimately need the word.
